Clients POST an absolute http/https URL and receive a new, independent short link with a random 7-character base62 code. GET /{code} returns a 302 redirect to the long URL and atomically increments the click count and last-click timestamp. Separate endpoints return link details and click analytics. Errors are returned as application/problem+json, and unknown codes return 404.","endpoints":[{"endpoint":"POST /api/links","purpose":"Create a new short link from JSON {url}. Returns 201 with a Location header /api/links/{code} and a ShortLink body (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 400 for an invalid or malformed body, 415 for a non-JSON content type, and 500 for unexpected errors."},{"endpoint":"GET /api/links/{code}","purpose":"Return link details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 404 if the code is unknown."},{"endpoint":"GET /api/links/{code}/analytics","purpose":"Return click analytics (shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt, which is null if the link was never clicked). Returns 404 if the code is unknown."},{"endpoint":"GET /{code}","purpose":"Return a 302 redirect with Location set to the long URL and Cache-Control: no-store, and count the click. Returns 404 if the code is unknown."}],"modules":[{"name":"ShortenerApplication","detail":"Spring Boot entry point."},{"name":"ServiceReadyListener","detail":"Prints 'SERVICE_READY port=<port>' on ApplicationReadyEvent."},{"name":"api.LinkController","detail":"Handles /api/links: create (POST), details (GET /{code}) and analytics (GET /{code}/analytics). Maps ShortLinkRecord to response DTOs and converts Instants with toString()."},{"name":"api.RedirectController","detail":"Handles GET /{code}. Calls LinkService.resolveAndCount and returns a 302 with Location and Cache-Control: no-store."},{"name":"api.ProblemExceptionHandler","detail":"@RestControllerAdvice that maps exceptions to problem+json responses: InvalidUrlException→400, HttpMessageNotReadable→400, HttpMediaTypeNotSupported→415, LinkNotFoundException→404, other ErrorResponse→its own status, and anything else→500 (logged)."},{"name":"api.CreateLinkRequest","detail":"Record(String url). This is the request body for create. Unknown JSON properties are ignored (Spring Boot default Jackson config)."},{"name":"api.ShortLinkResponse / api.LinkAnalyticsResponse","detail":"Response records: ShortLinkResponse(shortCode, longUrl, createdAt) and LinkAnalyticsResponse(shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt)."},{"name":"service.LinkService","detail":"Business logic. create validates the URL, generates a code, inserts with up to 5 retries on DuplicateKeyException, then re-reads the row. getDetails/getAnalytics call findByCode or throw LinkNotFoundException. resolveAndCount (@Transactional) runs incrementClick first, throws not-found if 0 rows are updated, then reads long_url. All times come from Instant.now(); there is no injectable Clock."},{"name":"service.UrlValidator","detail":"Rejects null/blank values, unparseable URIs, non-absolute URIs, non-http(s) schemes and URLs with an empty host by throwing InvalidUrlException."},{"name":"service.ShortCodeGenerator","detail":"Uses SecureRandom to produce 7-character codes from the base62 alphabet."},{"name":"service.InvalidUrlException / LinkNotFoundException","detail":"Domain exceptions that map to 400 and 404."},{"name":"persistence.ShortLinkRecord","detail":"Record(shortCode, longUrl, Instant createdAt, long clickCount, Instant lastClickedAt)."},{"name":"persistence.ShortLinkRepository","detail":"JdbcTemplate DAO. Stores timestamps as fixed-width UTC text 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ', truncated to microseconds. Methods: insert (translates SQLite UNIQUE violation to DuplicateKeyException), findByCode, incrementClick (UPDATE ... returns row count) and findLongUrl."},{"name":"resources/schema.sql + application.properties","detail":"schema.sql uses CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS and runs on every startup (spring.sql.init.mode=always). application.properties sets PORT (default 8080), DB_PATH (default app.db), a single-connection Hikari pool and problemdetails enabled."}],"tables":[{"name":"short_links","detail":"Columns: id INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT; short_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE (plus a redundant unique index ux_short_links_short_code); long_url TEXT NOT NULL; created_at TEXT NOT NULL (ISO-8601 UTC, microseconds); click_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK >= 0; last_clicked_at TEXT nullable. There is no expiry column."}],"data_flows":[{"name":"Create link","steps":["Client sends POST /api/links with Content-Type application/json and body {url}.","Jackson binds the body to CreateLinkRequest. A malformed or missing body returns 400; a wrong content type returns 415.","UrlValidator.validate(url) runs; an invalid URL returns 400 via InvalidUrlException and nothing is persisted.","createdAt is set to Instant.now().","Loop of up to 5 attempts: generate a code and insert the row (click_count 0, last_clicked_at NULL). A DuplicateKeyException triggers a retry.","findByCode re-reads the row.","Controller returns 201 with Location /api/links/{code} and body {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt}."]},{"name":"Get details","steps":["Client sends GET /api/links/{code}.","LinkService.getDetails calls findByCode, or throws LinkNotFoundException (404 problem+json).","Controller returns 200 with {shortCode, longUrl, createdAt}."]},{"name":"Get analytics","steps":["Client sends GET /api/links/{code}/analytics.","LinkService.getAnalytics delegates to getDetails, which calls findByCode or returns 404.","Controller returns 200 with {shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt or null}."]},{"name":"Redirect","steps":["Client sends GET /{code}.","LinkService.resolveAndCount runs inside a transaction.","UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = now WHERE short_code = ?","If 0 rows are updated, LinkNotFoundException is thrown and the response is 404 problem+json.","findLongUrl(code) is read.","Controller returns 302 with Location: longUrl and Cache-Control: no-store."]}],"impacted":[{"name":"resources/schema.sql (table short_links)","detail":"Needs a new nullable column, e.g. expires_at TEXT, where NULL means the link never expires. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS will not add the column to existing app.db files. An idempotent migration is required. SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, and the script runs on every startup, so a plain ALTER TABLE would fail on the second start. A PRAGMA table_info check in Java or a migration tool is needed."},{"name":"api.CreateLinkRequest","detail":"Add an optional expiry-in-days field (name to be decided, e.g. expiresInDays, as Integer/Long so that 'absent' is distinguishable)."},{"name":"service.LinkService.create","detail":"Validate the optional days value: reject zero, negative, non-integral and too-large values with 400. Compute expiresAt = createdAt + days and pass it to the repository."},{"name":"Validation / new exception","detail":"InvalidUrlException's handler hard-codes the detail 'url must be an absolute http or https URL'. Expiry validation needs its own exception, or a generalised handler, so the 400 detail is accurate."},{"name":"service.LinkService.resolveAndCount","detail":"Must detect expiry and fail with a new LinkExpiredException instead of redirecting. Today it increments before reading, so an expired link would still be counted unless the logic changes. One option is UPDATE ... WHERE short_code=? AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now), then a lookup to tell unknown (404) apart from expired (410)."},{"name":"service.LinkExpiredException (new)","detail":"New domain exception that maps to 410 Gone."},{"name":"api.ProblemExceptionHandler","detail":"Add a handler for LinkExpiredException that returns 410 problem+json with title 'Gone'. Without it, the catch-all would return 500."},{"name":"GET /{code} (RedirectController)","detail":"Gains a new 410 response for expired links. The 302 and 404 behaviour is otherwise unchanged."},{"name":"POST /api/links (LinkController.create)","detail":"Accepts the new optional field and passes it to the service. The response likely gains an expiresAt field."},{"name":"api.ShortLinkResponse and LinkController.toResponse","detail":"Optionally expose expiresAt (null when the link never expires) in create and details responses. This is an additive response field."},{"name":"persistence.ShortLinkRecord","detail":"Add an Instant expiresAt component. This changes the canonical constructor, so the MAPPER and all constructor call sites must be updated."},{"name":"persistence.ShortLinkRepository","detail":"Changes needed in: insert (signature and SQL), the MAPPER and the SELECT column list in findByCode, and incrementClick/findLongUrl (expiry-aware query or a separate expiry lookup). expires_at must use the same fixed-width format() so SQLite text comparison orders correctly."},{"name":"GET /api/links/{code} and /analytics","detail":"Not required to change by the request, but must be explicitly decided. The assumption is that they keep returning 200 for expired links. Details may show expiresAt."},{"name":"Time source (Instant.now in LinkService)","detail":"Testing expiry measured in days needs an injectable java.time.Clock bean, or direct DB manipulation in tests."},{"name":"Tests: ShortLinkRepositoryTest","detail":"Calls repo.insert(code, url, instant) and will break if the signature changes, unless an overload is kept. Needs new tests for storing and reading expiry."},{"name":"Tests: LinkServiceTest","detail":"Needs new cases: expiry computation, invalid days, an expired link throwing LinkExpiredException without incrementing clicks, and links without expiry never expiring."},{"name":"Tests: LinkApiTest","detail":"Needs new cases: create with expiry, 400 for bad expiry values, 410 problem+json on an expired redirect, 404 still returned for unknown codes, and details/analytics behaviour for expired links. Existing tests should pass unchanged."},{"name":"Tests: ShortenerApplicationTests","detail":"Schema-apply smoke test. It should also confirm that the migration runs on a fresh DB and on a pre-existing DB."},{"name":"docs/API.md and README.md","detail":"Document the new request field, the response field, the 410 response on GET /{code}, and the expiry semantics."}],"compatibility_risks":["Create requests without an expiry field must still return 201 with the same Location and body. The resulting links must never expire. A required field or a non-null default would break existing clients.","Existing databases created before the change lack expires_at. If schema.sql only edits CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, every SELECT or INSERT that references expires_at fails with a 500 on upgraded deployments. A non-idempotent ALTER TABLE in schema.sql would make the second startup fail, because the script runs on every boot. Existing rows must end up with NULL (never expire).","Unknown JSON properties are currently ignored: LinkApiTest sends \"alias\":\"mine\" and expects 201. Enabling strict deserialization to validate the new field would break this and the 'no custom alias' contract.","GET /{code} for an unknown code must stay 404, not 410. Valid, non-expired links must keep the 302 with the Location header and Cache-Control: no-store.","Click semantics: each successful redirect increments click_count by exactly one and updates last_clicked_at. With the current increment-then-read order, a naive expiry check placed after the increment would count clicks on expired links. Product needs to confirm that 410 responses are not counted. The expiry check and increment should be atomic (single UPDATE with an expiry predicate, or check-then-update within the existing transaction).","Details and analytics endpoints must keep returning 200 with their current fields for every existing link. Whether expired links return 200 or 410 there is unspecified; returning 410 would change existing contracts.","Adding expiresAt to ShortLinkResponse is additive, but Jackson serialises nulls by default. Non-expiring links would then show \"expiresAt\": null, which strict clients may not expect. This is acceptable but must be documented.","Error format must stay application/problem+json with type, title, status and detail. The new 410 must follow it with title 'Gone'. A missing handler would produce a 500 via the catch-all.","Validation of days: Jackson by default coerces strings ('7'→7) and truncates floats (1.9→1). Very large values can overflow Instant.plus and produce a 500, or yield years beyond 9999 that break the fixed-width timestamp format and lexicographic comparison. Zero and negative values need a defined 400. Validation failures must not persist a row, mirroring the 'invalid URL persists nothing' guarantee.","Boundary semantics at exactly expiresAt (expired when now >= expiresAt?) and the meaning of 'days' (24h multiples from createdAt vs calendar days) must be defined. All comparisons must use the same UTC microsecond text format so SQLite string comparison stays correct.","Changing the ShortLinkRecord constructor and ShortLinkRepository.insert signature breaks compilation of existing callers and ShortLinkRepositoryTest unless overloads are kept or the tests are updated.","Retry-on-collision logic in create must still pass expiresAt on every attempt, and createdAt and expiresAt must be derived from the same instant."]}

data.title: Stage 0 Codebase · approve impact analysis (codebase_analysis v1 (19add5e4a4c8))
data.shown:
A public (unauthenticated) Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 URL shortener backed by SQLite through JdbcTemplate. Clients POST an absolute http/https URL and receive a new, independent short link with a random 7-character base62 code. GET /{code} returns a 302 redirect to the long URL and atomically increments the click count and last-click timestamp. Separate endpoints return link details and click analytics. Errors are returned as application/problem+json, and unknown codes return 404.

Stack (kept): java21-springboot3-maven   HEAD: 9c093950
Endpoints: POST /api/links, GET /api/links/{code}, GET /api/links/{code}/analytics, GET /{code}

Impacted:
  - resources/schema.sql (table short_links): Needs a new nullable column, e.g. expires_at TEXT, where NULL means the link never expires. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS will not add the column to existing app.db files. An idempotent migration is required. SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, and the script runs on every startup, so a plain ALTER TABLE would fail on the second start. A PRAGMA table_info check in Java or a migration tool is needed.
  - api.CreateLinkRequest: Add an optional expiry-in-days field (name to be decided, e.g. expiresInDays, as Integer/Long so that 'absent' is distinguishable).
  - service.LinkService.create: Validate the optional days value: reject zero, negative, non-integral and too-large values with 400. Compute expiresAt = createdAt + days and pass it to the repository.
  - Validation / new exception: InvalidUrlException's handler hard-codes the detail 'url must be an absolute http or https URL'. Expiry validation needs its own exception, or a generalised handler, so the 400 detail is accurate.
  - service.LinkService.resolveAndCount: Must detect expiry and fail with a new LinkExpiredException instead of redirecting. Today it increments before reading, so an expired link would still be counted unless the logic changes. One option is UPDATE ... WHERE short_code=? AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now), then a lookup to tell unknown (404) apart from expired (410).
  - service.LinkExpiredException (new): New domain exception that maps to 410 Gone.
  - api.ProblemExceptionHandler: Add a handler for LinkExpiredException that returns 410 problem+json with title 'Gone'. Without it, the catch-all would return 500.
  - GET /{code} (RedirectController): Gains a new 410 response for expired links. The 302 and 404 behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
  - POST /api/links (LinkController.create): Accepts the new optional field and passes it to the service. The response likely gains an expiresAt field.
  - api.ShortLinkResponse and LinkController.toResponse: Optionally expose expiresAt (null when the link never expires) in create and details responses. This is an additive response field.
  - persistence.ShortLinkRecord: Add an Instant expiresAt component. This changes the canonical constructor, so the MAPPER and all constructor call sites must be updated.
  - persistence.ShortLinkRepository: Changes needed in: insert (signature and SQL), the MAPPER and the SELECT column list in findByCode, and incrementClick/findLongUrl (expiry-aware query or a separate expiry lookup). expires_at must use the same fixed-width format() so SQLite text comparison orders correctly.
  - GET /api/links/{code} and /analytics: Not required to change by the request, but must be explicitly decided. The assumption is that they keep returning 200 for expired links. Details may show expiresAt.
  - Time source (Instant.now in LinkService): Testing expiry measured in days needs an injectable java.time.Clock bean, or direct DB manipulation in tests.
  - Tests: ShortLinkRepositoryTest: Calls repo.insert(code, url, instant) and will break if the signature changes, unless an overload is kept. Needs new tests for storing and reading expiry.
  - Tests: LinkServiceTest: Needs new cases: expiry computation, invalid days, an expired link throwing LinkExpiredException without incrementing clicks, and links without expiry never expiring.
  - Tests: LinkApiTest: Needs new cases: create with expiry, 400 for bad expiry values, 410 problem+json on an expired redirect, 404 still returned for unknown codes, and details/analytics behaviour for expired links. Existing tests should pass unchanged.
  - Tests: ShortenerApplicationTests: Schema-apply smoke test. It should also confirm that the migration runs on a fresh DB and on a pre-existing DB.
  - docs/API.md and README.md: Document the new request field, the response field, the 410 response on GET /{code}, and the expiry semantics.

Compatibility risks:
  - Create requests without an expiry field must still return 201 with the same Location and body. The resulting links must never expire. A required field or a non-null default would break existing clients.
  - Existing databases created before the change lack expires_at. If schema.sql only edits CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, every SELECT or INSERT that references expires_at fails with a 500 on upgraded deployments. A non-idempotent ALTER TABLE in schema.sql would make the second startup fail, because the script runs on every boot. Existing rows must end up with NULL (never expire).
  - Unknown JSON properties are currently ignored: LinkApiTest sends "alias":"mine" and expects 201. Enabling strict deserialization to validate the new field would break this and the 'no custom alias' contract.
  - GET /{code} for an unknown code must stay 404, not 410. Valid, non-expired links must keep the 302 with the Location header and Cache-Control: no-store.
  - Click semantics: each successful redirect increments click_count by exactly one and updates last_clicked_at. With the current increment-then-read order, a naive expiry check placed after the increment would count clicks on expired links. Product needs to confirm that 410 responses are not counted. The expiry check and increment should be atomic (single UPDATE with an expiry predicate, or check-then-update within the existing transaction).
  - Details and analytics endpoints must keep returning 200 with their current fields for every existing link. Whether expired links return 200 or 410 there is unspecified; returning 410 would change existing contracts.
  - Adding expiresAt to ShortLinkResponse is additive, but Jackson serialises nulls by default. Non-expiring links would then show "expiresAt": null, which strict clients may not expect. This is acceptable but must be documented.

# Existing system and change impact

A public (unauthenticated) Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 URL shortener backed by SQLite through JdbcTemplate. Clients POST an absolute http/https URL and receive a new, independent short link with a random 7-character base62 code. GET /{code} returns a 302 redirect to the long URL and atomically increments the click count and last-click timestamp. Separate endpoints return link details and click analytics. Errors are returned as application/problem+json, and unknown codes return 404.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/links` — Create a new short link from JSON {url}. Returns 201 with a Location header /api/links/{code} and a ShortLink body (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 400 for an invalid or malformed body, 415 for a non-JSON content type, and 500 for unexpected errors.
- `GET /api/links/{code}` — Return link details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /api/links/{code}/analytics` — Return click analytics (shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt, which is null if the link was never clicked). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /{code}` — Return a 302 redirect with Location set to the long URL and Cache-Control: no-store, and count the click. Returns 404 if the code is unknown.

## Impacted

- **resources/schema.sql (table short_links)** — Needs a new nullable column, e.g. expires_at TEXT, where NULL means the link never expires. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS will not add the column to existing app.db files. An idempotent migration is required. SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, and the script runs on every startup, so a plain ALTER TABLE would fail on the second start. A PRAGMA table_info check in Java or a migration tool is needed.
- **api.CreateLinkRequest** — Add an optional expiry-in-days field (name to be decided, e.g. expiresInDays, as Integer/Long so that 'absent' is distinguishable).
- **service.LinkService.create** — Validate the optional days value: reject zero, negative, non-integral and too-large values with 400. Compute expiresAt = createdAt + days and pass it to the repository.
- **Validation / new exception** — InvalidUrlException's handler hard-codes the detail 'url must be an absolute http or https URL'. Expiry validation needs its own exception, or a generalised handler, so the 400 detail is accurate.
- **service.LinkService.resolveAndCount** — Must detect expiry and fail with a new LinkExpiredException instead of redirecting. Today it increments before reading, so an expired link would still be counted unless the logic changes. One option is UPDATE ... WHERE short_code=? AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now), then a lookup to tell unknown (404) apart from expired (410).
- **service.LinkExpiredException (new)** — New domain exception that maps to 410 Gone.
- **api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — Add a handler for LinkExpiredException that returns 410 problem+json with title 'Gone'. Without it, the catch-all would return 500.
- **GET /{code} (RedirectController)** — Gains a new 410 response for expired links. The 302 and 404 behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
- **POST /api/links (LinkController.create)** — Accepts the new optional field and passes it to the service. The response likely gains an expiresAt field.
- **api.ShortLinkResponse and LinkController.toResponse** — Optionally expose expiresAt (null when the link never expires) in create and details responses. This is an additive response field.
- **persistence.ShortLinkRecord** — Add an Instant expiresAt component. This changes the canonical constructor, so the MAPPER and all constructor call sites must be updated.
- **persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — Changes needed in: insert (signature and SQL), the MAPPER and the SELECT column list in findByCode, and incrementClick/findLongUrl (expiry-aware query or a separate expiry lookup). expires_at must use the same fixed-width format() so SQLite text comparison orders correctly.
- **GET /api/links/{code} and /analytics** — Not required to change by the request, but must be explicitly decided. The assumption is that they keep returning 200 for expired links. Details may show expiresAt.
- **Time source (Instant.now in LinkService)** — Testing expiry measured in days needs an injectable java.time.Clock bean, or direct DB manipulation in tests.
- **Tests: ShortLinkRepositoryTest** — Calls repo.insert(code, url, instant) and will break if the signature changes, unless an overload is kept. Needs new tests for storing and reading expiry.
- **Tests: LinkServiceTest** — Needs new cases: expiry computation, invalid days, an expired link throwing LinkExpiredException without incrementing clicks, and links without expiry never expiring.
- **Tests: LinkApiTest** — Needs new cases: create with expiry, 400 for bad expiry values, 410 problem+json on an expired redirect, 404 still returned for unknown codes, and details/analytics behaviour for expired links. Existing tests should pass unchanged.
- **Tests: ShortenerApplicationTests** — Schema-apply smoke test. It should also confirm that the migration runs on a fresh DB and on a pre-existing DB.
- **docs/API.md and README.md** — Document the new request field, the response field, the 410 response on GET /{code}, and the expiry semantics.

## Compatibility risks

- Create requests without an expiry field must still return 201 with the same Location and body. The resulting links must never expire. A required field or a non-null default would break existing clients.
- Existing databases created before the change lack expires_at. If schema.sql only edits CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, every SELECT or INSERT that references expires_at fails with a 500 on upgraded deployments. A non-idempotent ALTER TABLE in schema.sql would make the second startup fail, because the script runs on every boot. Existing rows must end up with NULL (never expire).
- Unknown JSON properties are currently ignored: LinkApiTest sends "alias":"mine" and expects 201. Enabling strict deserialization to validate the new field would break this and the 'no custom alias' contract.
- GET /{code} for an unknown code must stay 404, not 410. Valid, non-expired links must keep the 302 with the Location header and Cache-Control: no-store.
- Click semantics: each successful redirect increments click_count by exactly one and updates last_clicked_at. With the current increment-then-read order, a naive expiry check placed after the increment would count clicks on expired links. Product needs to confirm that 410 responses are not counted. The expiry check and increment should be atomic (single UPDATE with an expiry predicate, or check-then-update within the existing transaction).
- Details and analytics endpoints must keep returning 200 with their current fields for every existing link. Whether expired links return 200 or 410 there is unspecified; returning 410 would change existing contracts.

- Error format must stay application/problem+json with type, title, status and detail. The new 410 must follow it with title 'Gone'. A missing handler would produce a 500 via the catch-all.
- Validation of days: Jackson by default coerces strings ('7'→7) and truncates floats (1.9→1). Very large values can overflow Instant.plus and produce a 500, or yield years beyond 9999 that break the fixed-width timestamp format and lexicographic comparison. Zero and negative values need a defined 400. Validation failures must not persist a row, mirroring the 'invalid URL persists nothing' guarantee.

- Retry-on-collision logic in create must still pass expiresAt on every attempt, and createdAt and expiresAt must be derived from the same instant.

# Existing system and change impact

A public (unauthenticated) Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 URL shortener backed by SQLite through JdbcTemplate. Clients POST an absolute http/https URL and receive a new, independent short link with a random 7-character base62 code. GET /{code} returns a 302 redirect to the long URL and atomically increments the click count and last-click timestamp. Separate endpoints return link details and click analytics. Errors are returned as application/problem+json, and unknown codes return 404.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/links` — Create a new short link from JSON {url}. Returns 201 with a Location header /api/links/{code} and a ShortLink body (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 400 for an invalid or malformed body, 415 for a non-JSON content type, and 500 for unexpected errors.
- `GET /api/links/{code}` — Return link details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /api/links/{code}/analytics` — Return click analytics (shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt, which is null if the link was never clicked). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /{code}` — Return a 302 redirect with Location set to the long URL and Cache-Control: no-store, and count the click. Returns 404 if the code is unknown.

Today it increments before reading, so an expired link would still be counted unless the logic changes. One option is UPDATE ... WHERE short_code=? <existing_system>
# Existing system and change impact

A public (unauthenticated) Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 URL shortener backed by SQLite through JdbcTemplate. Clients POST an absolute http/https URL and receive a new, independent short link with a random 7-character base62 code. GET /{code} returns a 302 redirect to the long URL and atomically increments the click count and last-click timestamp. Separate endpoints return link details and click analytics. Errors are returned as application/problem+json, and unknown codes return 404.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/links` — Create a new short link from JSON {url}. Returns 201 with a Location header /api/links/{code} and a ShortLink body (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 400 for an invalid or malformed body, 415 for a non-JSON content type, and 500 for unexpected errors.
- `GET /api/links/{code}` — Return link details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /api/links/{code}/analytics` — Return click analytics (shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt, which is null if the link was never clicked). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /{code}` — Return a 302 redirect with Location set to the long URL and Cache-Control: no-store, and count the click. Returns 404 if the code is unknown.

## Impacted

- **resources/schema.sql (table short_links)** — Needs a new nullable column, e.g. expires_at TEXT, where NULL means the link never expires. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS will not add the column to existing app.db files. An idempotent migration is required. SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, and the script runs on every startup, so a plain ALTER TABLE would fail on the second start. A PRAGMA table_info check in Java or a migration tool is needed.
- **api.CreateLinkRequest** — Add an optional expiry-in-days field (name to be decided, e.g. expiresInDays, as Integer/Long so that 'absent' is distinguishable).
- **service.LinkService.create** — Validate the optional days value: reject zero, negative, non-integral and too-large values with 400. Compute expiresAt = createdAt + days and pass it to the repository.
- **Validation / new exception** — InvalidUrlException's handler hard-codes the detail 'url must be an absolute http or https URL'. Expiry validation needs its own exception, or a generalised handler, so the 400 detail is accurate.
- **service.LinkService.resolveAndCount** — Must detect expiry and fail with a new LinkExpiredException instead of redirecting. Today it increments before reading, so an expired link would still be counted unless the logic changes. One option is UPDATE ... WHERE short_code=? AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now), then a lookup to tell unknown (404) apart from expired (410).
- **service.LinkExpiredException (new)** — New domain exception that maps to 410 Gone.
- **api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — Add a handler for LinkExpiredException that returns 410 problem+json with title 'Gone'. Without it, the catch-all would return 500.
- **GET /{code} (RedirectController)** — Gains a new 410 response for expired links. The 302 and 404 behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
- **POST /api/links (LinkController.create)** — Accepts the new optional field and passes it to the service. The response likely gains an expiresAt field.
- **api.ShortLinkResponse and LinkController.toResponse** — Optionally expose expiresAt (null when the link never expires) in create and details responses. This is an additive response field.
- **persistence.ShortLinkRecord** — Add an Instant expiresAt component. This changes the canonical constructor, so the MAPPER and all constructor call sites must be updated.
- **persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — Changes needed in: insert (signature and SQL), the MAPPER and the SELECT column list in findByCode, and incrementClick/findLongUrl (expiry-aware query or a separate expiry lookup). expires_at must use the same fixed-width format() so SQLite text comparison orders correctly.
- **GET /api/links/{code} and /analytics** — Not required to change by the request, but must be explicitly decided. The assumption is that they keep returning 200 for expired links. Details may show expiresAt.
- **Time source (Instant.now in LinkService)** — Testing expiry measured in days needs an injectable java.time.Clock bean, or direct DB manipulation in tests.
- **Tests: ShortLinkRepositoryTest** — Calls repo.insert(code, url, instant) and will break if the signature changes, unless an overload is kept. Needs new tests for storing and reading expiry.
- **Tests: LinkServiceTest** — Needs new cases: expiry computation, invalid days, an expired link throwing LinkExpiredException without incrementing clicks, and links without expiry never expiring.
- **Tests: LinkApiTest** — Needs new cases: create with expiry, 400 for bad expiry values, 410 problem+json on an expired redirect, 404 still returned for unknown codes, and details/analytics behaviour for expired links. Existing tests should pass unchanged.
- **Tests: ShortenerApplicationTests** — Schema-apply smoke test. It should also confirm that the migration runs on a fresh DB and on a pre-existing DB.
- **docs/API.md and README.md** — Document the new request field, the response field, the 410 response on GET /{code}, and the expiry semantics.

## Compatibility risks

- Create requests without an expiry field must still return 201 with the same Location and body. The resulting links must never expire. A required field or a non-null default would break existing clients.
- Existing databases created before the change lack expires_at. If schema.sql only edits CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, every SELECT or INSERT that references expires_at fails with a 500 on upgraded deployments. A non-idempotent ALTER TABLE in schema.sql would make the second startup fail, because the script runs on every boot. Existing rows must end up with NULL (never expire).
- Unknown JSON properties are currently ignored: LinkApiTest sends "alias":"mine" and expects 201. Enabling strict deserialization to validate the new field would break this and the 'no custom alias' contract.
- GET /{code} for an unknown code must stay 404, not 410. Valid, non-expired links must keep the 302 with the Location header and Cache-Control: no-store.
- Click semantics: each successful redirect increments click_count by exactly one and updates last_clicked_at. With the current increment-then-read order, a naive expiry check placed after the increment would count clicks on expired links. Product needs to confirm that 410 responses are not counted. The expiry check and increment should be atomic (single UPDATE with an expiry predicate, or check-then-update within the existing transaction).
- Details and analytics endpoints must keep returning 200 with their current fields for every existing link. Whether expired links return 200 or 410 there is unspecified; returning 410 would change existing contracts.
- Adding expiresAt to ShortLinkResponse is additive, but Jackson serialises nulls by default. Non-expiring links would then show "expiresAt": null, which strict clients may not expect. This is acceptable but must be documented.
- Error format must stay application/problem+json with type, title, status and detail. The new 410 must follow it with title 'Gone'. A missing handler would produce a 500 via the catch-all.
- Validation of days: Jackson by default coerces strings ('7'→7) and truncates floats (1.9→1). Very large values can overflow Instant.plus and produce a 500, or yield years beyond 9999 that break the fixed-width timestamp format and lexicographic comparison. Zero and negative values need a defined 400. Validation failures must not persist a row, mirroring the 'invalid URL persists nothing' guarantee.
- Boundary semantics at exactly expiresAt (expired when now >= expiresAt?) and the meaning of 'days' (24h multiples from createdAt vs calendar days) must be defined. All comparisons must use the same UTC microsecond text format so SQLite string comparison stays correct.
- Changing the ShortLinkRecord constructor and ShortLinkRepository.insert signature breaks compilation of existing callers and ShortLinkRepositoryTest unless overloads are kept or the tests are updated.
- Retry-on-collision logic in create must still pass expiresAt on every attempt, and createdAt and expiresAt must be derived from the same instant.

</existing_system>

<requirement>
Add optional link expiry: when creating a short link the client may give an expiry in days. After it expires, the redirect returns 410 Gone instead of redirecting. Links without an expiry never expire.

</requirement>

<clarifications>
C-1: Which expiry values are valid, and what happens with invalid ones (zero, negative, fractional, numeric strings like "7", or very large numbers)? → Accept only whole-number JSON integers from 1 to 3650 inclusive. Reject zero, negative, fractional, string and out-of-range values with 400 application/problem+json whose detail describes the expiry problem. Persist nothing on rejection.
C-2: Should a GET /{code} that returns 410 for an expired link increase the click count or update the last-click time? → No. Only successful 302 redirects are counted. A 410 response leaves clickCount and lastClickedAt unchanged.
C-3: What should GET /api/links/{code} and GET /api/links/{code}/analytics return for an expired link? → Keep returning 200 with the current fields. Only the redirect endpoint returns 410.
C-4: Should the link's computed expiry timestamp (e.g. expiresAt) be exposed in the create (POST /api/links) and details (GET /api/links/{code}) responses? If so, how should it appear for links that never expire? → Do not add any new response field. Keep create and details responses exactly as today, per C-3's 'current fields'.
</clarifications>

Functional: 15 (15 MVP)   NFRs: 0   Acceptance criteria: 26   Assumptions: 6

  FR-1 [MVP] POST /api/links accepts an optional expiry field named expiresInDays in the JSON request body, giving the number of days until the link expires. The field name rests on assumption A-1 (open question Q-1, pending reviewer confirmation).
  FR-2 [MVP] An expiresInDays value that is a whole-number JSON integer from 1 to 3650 inclusive is accepted. The link is created with 201, and the Location header and body are the same as for a create request without expiry.
  FR-3 [MVP] An expiresInDays value that is zero, negative, fractional, a string (e.g. "7") or outside 1..3650 is rejected with 400 application/problem+json. The detail describes the expiry problem and does not use the URL validation message.
  FR-4 [MVP] When a create request is rejected because of its expiry value, no link is persisted.
  FR-5 [MVP] GET /{code} for an existing link whose expiry has passed returns 410 instead of a 302 redirect. The response is application/problem+json with type, title 'Gone', status 410 and detail, and it has no Location header.
  FR-6 [MVP] A link's expiry instant is its creation time plus N × 24 hours (UTC), where N is expiresInDays. The link is expired when the current time is greater than or equal to the expiry instant (assumption A-4).
  FR-7 [MVP] A link created without expiresInDays never expires and keeps redirecting with 302 indefinitely. This includes every link that existed before this change.
  FR-8 [MVP] An explicit JSON null for expiresInDays is treated the same as an absent field. The request returns 201 and the link never expires (assumption A-2).
  FR-9 [MVP] A JSON number with an integral value but written with a fraction or exponent (e.g. 7.0 or 7e0) is not a whole-number JSON integer. It is rejected with 400 application/problem+json, and nothing is persisted (assumption A-3).
  FR-10 [MVP] A 410 response for an expired link does not change the link's clickCount or lastClickedAt. Only successful 302 redirects are counted.
  FR-11 [MVP] For a link with an expiry that has not yet passed, GET /{code} returns 302 with Location set to the long URL and Cache-Control: no-store. It also increments clickCount by exactly one and updates lastClickedAt.
  FR-12 [MVP] GET /{code} for an unknown code still returns 404, not 410. 410 is returned only for existing links that have expired.
  FR-13 [MVP] For an expired link, GET /api/links/{code} and GET /api/links/{code}/analytics keep returning 200 with their current fields. Only the redirect endpoint returns 410.
  FR-14 [MVP] No new response field (such as expiresAt) is added. Create and details responses keep exactly their current fields, whether or not an expiry was given. Unknown request properties other than expiresInDays (e.g. "alias") are still ignored, and the request still returns 201.
  FR-15 [MVP] The 410 response carries a generic detail such as 'short link has expired' and the header Cache-Control: no-store (assumption A-5).

  A-2 An explicit JSON null for expiresInDays is treated as absent. The request returns 201 and the link never expires.
  A-3 Only JSON integer literals count as whole-number JSON integers. Integral values written with a fraction or exponent (7.0, 7e0) are rejected with 400.

<existing_system>
# Existing system and change impact

A public (unauthenticated) Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 URL shortener backed by SQLite through JdbcTemplate. Clients POST an absolute http/https URL and receive a new, independent short link with a random 7-character base62 code. GET /{code} returns a 302 redirect to the long URL and atomically increments the click count and last-click timestamp. Separate endpoints return link details and click analytics. Errors are returned as application/problem+json, and unknown codes return 404.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/links` — Create a new short link from JSON {url}. Returns 201 with a Location header /api/links/{code} and a ShortLink body (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 400 for an invalid or malformed body, 415 for a non-JSON content type, and 500 for unexpected errors.
- `GET /api/links/{code}` — Return link details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /api/links/{code}/analytics` — Return click analytics (shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt, which is null if the link was never clicked). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /{code}` — Return a 302 redirect with Location set to the long URL and Cache-Control: no-store, and count the click. Returns 404 if the code is unknown.

## Impacted

- **resources/schema.sql (table short_links)** — Needs a new nullable column, e.g. expires_at TEXT, where NULL means the link never expires. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS will not add the column to existing app.db files. An idempotent migration is required. SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, and the script runs on every startup, so a plain ALTER TABLE would fail on the second start. A PRAGMA table_info check in Java or a migration tool is needed.
- **api.CreateLinkRequest** — Add an optional expiry-in-days field (name to be decided, e.g. expiresInDays, as Integer/Long so that 'absent' is distinguishable).
- **service.LinkService.create** — Validate the optional days value: reject zero, negative, non-integral and too-large values with 400. Compute expiresAt = createdAt + days and pass it to the repository.
- **Validation / new exception** — InvalidUrlException's handler hard-codes the detail 'url must be an absolute http or https URL'. Expiry validation needs its own exception, or a generalised handler, so the 400 detail is accurate.
- **service.LinkService.resolveAndCount** — Must detect expiry and fail with a new LinkExpiredException instead of redirecting. Today it increments before reading, so an expired link would still be counted unless the logic changes. One option is UPDATE ... WHERE short_code=? AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now), then a lookup to tell unknown (404) apart from expired (410).
- **service.LinkExpiredException (new)** — New domain exception that maps to 410 Gone.
- **api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — Add a handler for LinkExpiredException that returns 410 problem+json with title 'Gone'. Without it, the catch-all would return 500.
- **GET /{code} (RedirectController)** — Gains a new 410 response for expired links. The 302 and 404 behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
- **POST /api/links (LinkController.create)** — Accepts the new optional field and passes it to the service. The response likely gains an expiresAt field.
- **api.ShortLinkResponse and LinkController.toResponse** — Optionally expose expiresAt (null when the link never expires) in create and details responses. This is an additive response field.
- **persistence.ShortLinkRecord** — Add an Instant expiresAt component. This changes the canonical constructor, so the MAPPER and all constructor call sites must be updated.
- **persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — Changes needed in: insert (signature and SQL), the MAPPER and the SELECT column list in findByCode, and incrementClick/findLongUrl (expiry-aware query or a separate expiry lookup). expires_at must use the same fixed-width format() so SQLite text comparison orders correctly.
- **GET /api/links/{code} and /analytics** — Not required to change by the request, but must be explicitly decided. The assumption is that they keep returning 200 for expired links. Details may show expiresAt.
- **Time source (Instant.now in LinkService)** — Testing expiry measured in days needs an injectable java.time.Clock bean, or direct DB manipulation in tests.
- **Tests: ShortLinkRepositoryTest** — Calls repo.insert(code, url, instant) and will break if the signature changes, unless an overload is kept. Needs new tests for storing and reading expiry.
- **Tests: LinkServiceTest** — Needs new cases: expiry computation, invalid days, an expired link throwing LinkExpiredException without incrementing clicks, and links without expiry never expiring.
- **Tests: LinkApiTest** — Needs new cases: create with expiry, 400 for bad expiry values, 410 problem+json on an expired redirect, 404 still returned for unknown codes, and details/analytics behaviour for expired links. Existing tests should pass unchanged.
- **Tests: ShortenerApplicationTests** — Schema-apply smoke test. It should also confirm that the migration runs on a fresh DB and on a pre-existing DB.
- **docs/API.md and README.md** — Document the new request field, the response field, the 410 response on GET /{code}, and the expiry semantics.

## Compatibility risks

- Create requests without an expiry field must still return 201 with the same Location and body. The resulting links must never expire. A required field or a non-null default would break existing clients.
- Existing databases created before the change lack expires_at. If schema.sql only edits CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, every SELECT or INSERT that references expires_at fails with a 500 on upgraded deployments. A non-idempotent ALTER TABLE in schema.sql would make the second startup fail, because the script runs on every boot. Existing rows must end up with NULL (never expire).
- Unknown JSON properties are currently ignored: LinkApiTest sends "alias":"mine" and expects 201. Enabling strict deserialization to validate the new field would break this and the 'no custom alias' contract.
- GET /{code} for an unknown code must stay 404, not 410. Valid, non-expired links must keep the 302 with the Location header and Cache-Control: no-store.
- Click semantics: each successful redirect increments click_count by exactly one and updates last_clicked_at. With the current increment-then-read order, a naive expiry check placed after the increment would count clicks on expired links. Product needs to confirm that 410 responses are not counted. The expiry check and increment should be atomic (single UPDATE with an expiry predicate, or check-then-update within the existing transaction).
- Details and analytics endpoints must keep returning 200 with their current fields for every existing link. Whether expired links return 200 or 410 there is unspecified; returning 410 would change existing contracts.
- Adding expiresAt to ShortLinkResponse is additive, but Jackson serialises nulls by default. Non-expiring links would then show "expiresAt": null, which strict clients may not expect. This is acceptable but must be documented.
- Error format must stay application/problem+json with type, title, status and detail. The new 410 must follow it with title 'Gone'. A missing handler would produce a 500 via the catch-all.
- Validation of days: Jackson by default coerces strings ('7'→7) and truncates floats (1.9→1). Very large values can overflow Instant.plus and produce a 500, or yield years beyond 9999 that break the fixed-width timestamp format and lexicographic comparison. Zero and negative values need a defined 400. Validation failures must not persist a row, mirroring the 'invalid URL persists nothing' guarantee.
- Boundary semantics at exactly expiresAt (expired when now >= expiresAt?) and the meaning of 'days' (24h multiples from createdAt vs calendar days) must be defined. All comparisons must use the same UTC microsecond text format so SQLite string comparison stays correct.
- Changing the ShortLinkRecord constructor and ShortLinkRepository.insert signature breaks compilation of existing callers and ShortLinkRepositoryTest unless overloads are kept or the tests are updated.
- Retry-on-collision logic in create must still pass expiresAt on every attempt, and createdAt and expiresAt must be derived from the same instant.

</existing_system>

      "id": "A-5",

  "not_supported": [],
  "constraints": [],

      "id": "C-1",
      "question": "Which expiry values are valid, and what happens with invalid ones (zero, negative, fractional, numeric strings like \"7\", or very large numbers)?",
      "answer": "Accept only whole-number JSON integers from 1 to 3650 inclusive. Reject zero, negative, fractional, string and out-of-range values with 400 application/problem+json whose detail describes the expiry problem. Persist nothing on rejection."
    },
    {
      "id": "C-2",
      "question": "Should a GET /{code} that returns 410 for an expired link increase the click count or update the last-click time?",
      "answer": "No. Only successful 302 redirects are counted. A 410 response leaves clickCount and lastClickedAt unchanged."
    },
    {
      "id": "C-3",
      "question": "What should GET /api/links/{code} and GET /api/links/{code}/analytics return for an expired link?",
      "answer": "Keep returning 200 with the current fields. Only the redirect endpoint returns 410."
    },
    {
      "id": "C-4",
      "question": "Should the link's computed expiry timestamp (e.g. expiresAt) be exposed in the create (POST /api/links) and details (GET /api/links/{code}) responses? If so, how should it appear for links that never expire?",

<existing_system>
# Existing system and change impact

A public (unauthenticated) Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 URL shortener backed by SQLite through JdbcTemplate. Clients POST an absolute http/https URL and receive a new, independent short link with a random 7-character base62 code. GET /{code} returns a 302 redirect to the long URL and atomically increments the click count and last-click timestamp. Separate endpoints return link details and click analytics. Errors are returned as application/problem+json, and unknown codes return 404.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/links` — Create a new short link from JSON {url}. Returns 201 with a Location header /api/links/{code} and a ShortLink body (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 400 for an invalid or malformed body, 415 for a non-JSON content type, and 500 for unexpected errors.
- `GET /api/links/{code}` — Return link details (shortCode, longUrl, createdAt). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /api/links/{code}/analytics` — Return click analytics (shortCode, clickCount, lastClickedAt, which is null if the link was never clicked). Returns 404 if the code is unknown.
- `GET /{code}` — Return a 302 redirect with Location set to the long URL and Cache-Control: no-store, and count the click. Returns 404 if the code is unknown.

## Impacted

- **resources/schema.sql (table short_links)** — Needs a new nullable column, e.g. expires_at TEXT, where NULL means the link never expires. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS will not add the column to existing app.db files. An idempotent migration is required. SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, and the script runs on every startup, so a plain ALTER TABLE would fail on the second start. A PRAGMA table_info check in Java or a migration tool is needed.
- **api.CreateLinkRequest** — Add an optional expiry-in-days field (name to be decided, e.g. expiresInDays, as Integer/Long so that 'absent' is distinguishable).
- **service.LinkService.create** — Validate the optional days value: reject zero, negative, non-integral and too-large values with 400. Compute expiresAt = createdAt + days and pass it to the repository.
- **Validation / new exception** — InvalidUrlException's handler hard-codes the detail 'url must be an absolute http or https URL'. Expiry validation needs its own exception, or a generalised handler, so the 400 detail is accurate.
- **service.LinkService.resolveAndCount** — Must detect expiry and fail with a new LinkExpiredException instead of redirecting. Today it increments before reading, so an expired link would still be counted unless the logic changes. One option is UPDATE ... WHERE short_code=? AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now), then a lookup to tell unknown (404) apart from expired (410).
- **service.LinkExpiredException (new)** — New domain exception that maps to 410 Gone.
- **api.ProblemExceptionHandler** — Add a handler for LinkExpiredException that returns 410 problem+json with title 'Gone'. Without it, the catch-all would return 500.
- **GET /{code} (RedirectController)** — Gains a new 410 response for expired links. The 302 and 404 behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
- **POST /api/links (LinkController.create)** — Accepts the new optional field and passes it to the service. The response likely gains an expiresAt field.
- **api.ShortLinkResponse and LinkController.toResponse** — Optionally expose expiresAt (null when the link never expires) in create and details responses. This is an additive response field.
- **persistence.ShortLinkRecord** — Add an Instant expiresAt component. This changes the canonical constructor, so the MAPPER and all constructor call sites must be updated.
- **persistence.ShortLinkRepository** — Changes needed in: insert (signature and SQL), the MAPPER and the SELECT column list in findByCode, and incrementClick/findLongUrl (expiry-aware query or a separate expiry lookup). expires_at must use the same fixed-width format() so SQLite text comparison orders correctly.
- **GET /api/links/{code} and /analytics** — Not required to change by the request, but must be explicitly decided. The assumption is that they keep returning 200 for expired links. Details may show expiresAt.
- **Time source (Instant.now in LinkService)** — Testing expiry measured in days needs an injectable java.time.Clock bean, or direct DB manipulation in tests.
- **Tests: ShortLinkRepositoryTest** — Calls repo.insert(code, url, instant) and will break if the signature changes, unless an overload is kept. Needs new tests for storing and reading expiry.
- **Tests: LinkServiceTest** — Needs new cases: expiry computation, invalid days, an expired link throwing LinkExpiredException without incrementing clicks, and links without expiry never expiring.
- **Tests: LinkApiTest** — Needs new cases: create with expiry, 400 for bad expiry values, 410 problem+json on an expired redirect, 404 still returned for unknown codes, and details/analytics behaviour for expired links. Existing tests should pass unchanged.
- **Tests: ShortenerApplicationTests** — Schema-apply smoke test. It should also confirm that the migration runs on a fresh DB and on a pre-existing DB.
- **docs/API.md and README.md** — Document the new request field, the response field, the 410 response on GET /{code}, and the expiry semantics.

## Compatibility risks

- Create requests without an expiry field must still return 201 with the same Location and body. The resulting links must never expire. A required field or a non-null default would break existing clients.
- Existing databases created before the change lack expires_at. If schema.sql only edits CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, every SELECT or INSERT that references expires_at fails with a 500 on upgraded deployments. A non-idempotent ALTER TABLE in schema.sql would make the second startup fail, because the script runs on every boot. Existing rows must end up with NULL (never expire).
- Unknown JSON properties are currently ignored: LinkApiTest sends "alias":"mine" and expects 201. Enabling strict deserialization to validate the new field would break this and the 'no custom alias' contract.
- GET /{code} for an unknown code must stay 404, not 410. Valid, non-expired links must keep the 302 with the Location header and Cache-Control: no-store.
- Click semantics: each successful redirect increments click_count by exactly one and updates last_clicked_at. With the current increment-then-read order, a naive expiry check placed after the increment would count clicks on expired links. Product needs to confirm that 410 responses are not counted. The expiry check and increment should be atomic (single UPDATE with an expiry predicate, or check-then-update within the existing transaction).
- Details and analytics endpoints must keep returning 200 with their current fields for every existing link. Whether expired links return 200 or 410 there is unspecified; returning 410 would change existing contracts.
- Adding expiresAt to ShortLinkResponse is additive, but Jackson serialises nulls by default. Non-expiring links would then show "expiresAt": null, which strict clients may not expect. This is acceptable but must be documented.
- Error format must stay application/problem+json with type, title, status and detail. The new 410 must follow it with title 'Gone'. A missing handler would produce a 500 via the catch-all.
- Validation of days: Jackson by default coerces strings ('7'→7) and truncates floats (1.9→1). Very large values can overflow Instant.plus and produce a 500, or yield years beyond 9999 that break the fixed-width timestamp format and lexicographic comparison. Zero and negative values need a defined 400. Validation failures must not persist a row, mirroring the 'invalid URL persists nothing' guarantee.
- Boundary semantics at exactly expiresAt (expired when now >= expiresAt?) and the meaning of 'days' (24h multiples from createdAt vs calendar days) must be defined. All comparisons must use the same UTC microsecond text format so SQLite string comparison stays correct.
- Changing the ShortLinkRecord constructor and ShortLinkRepository.insert signature breaks compilation of existing callers and ShortLinkRepositoryTest unless overloads are kept or the tests are updated.
- Retry-on-collision logic in create must still pass expiresAt on every attempt, and createdAt and expiresAt must be derived from the same instant.

  short_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  long_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  click_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_clicked_at TEXT,
  expires_at TEXT
);
-- expires_at: nullable; NULL = never expires. Same fixed-width UTC microsecond text format as created_at so lexicographic comparison is chronological.
-- Existing databases: persistence.SchemaMigrator adds expires_at idempotently (PRAGMA table_info check, then ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN expires_at TEXT only if missing); existing rows get NULL.
","flows":[{"name":"Startup schema initialisation and migration","steps":["Spring SQL init runs schema.sql. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creates short_links with expires_at on a fresh database, and does nothing on an existing one.","SchemaMigrator (@DependsOnDatabaseInitialization) runs PRAGMA table_info(short_links).","If expires_at is missing, which is the case for a database created before this change, it runs ALTER TABLE short_links ADD COLUMN expires_at TEXT. Existing rows get NULL and never expire.","If expires_at is present, nothing happens, so the second and later restarts succeed.","ShortLinkRepository, which depends on SchemaMigrator, becomes available and the web server begins serving."]},{"name":"Create short link (POST /api/links)","steps":["Jackson binds the body to CreateLinkRequest. url is a String and expiresInDays is a raw JsonNode, so no coercion happens. Unknown properties such as alias are ignored. A malformed body returns 400 and a non-JSON content type returns 415.","LinkService validates the URL. If it is invalid, InvalidUrlException produces 400 with the URL detail and nothing is persisted.","ExpiryPolicy validates expiresInDays. A null or NullNode value means no expiry. An integral node with a BigInteger value in 1..3650 is accepted. Anything else (0, negative, 3651, 99999999999999999999, 1.5, 7.0, 7e0, "7", or a boolean, object or array) throws InvalidExpiryException, giving 400 with the expiry detail. Nothing is persisted.","createdAt = clock.instant(). expiresAt = createdAt + days x 24h, or null.","A random 7-character base62 code is generated and repository.insert(code, url, createdAt, expiresAt) is called. On a code collision the service retries with a new code and the same createdAt and expiresAt.","The controller returns 201 with Location /api/links/{code} and a body of exactly shortCode, longUrl and createdAt."]},{"name":"Redirect (GET /{code})","steps":["RedirectController calls LinkService.resolveAndCount(code) in a transaction, with now = clock.instant().","The repository runs UPDATE short_links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = :now WHERE short_code = :code AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > :now).","If one row is updated, the service reads long_url and the controller returns 302 with Location set to the long URL and Cache-Control: no-store.","If no row is updated and existsByCode(code) is true, LinkExpiredException is thrown. The handler returns 410 problem+json with title 'Gone', detail 'short link has expired' and Cache-Control: no-store, and no Location header. Clicks are unchanged.","If no row is updated and the code does not exist, LinkNotFoundException is thrown and the handler returns 404 problem+json."]},{"name":"Link details (GET /api/links/{code})","steps":["LinkController calls the repository's findByCode(code).","If the link is found, the controller returns 200 with exactly shortCode, longUrl and createdAt, whether or not the link has expired. expiresAt is not exposed.","If the link is not found, the response is 404 problem+json."]},{"name":"Link analytics (GET /api/links/{code}/analytics)","steps":["LinkController loads the record by code.","If the link is found, the controller returns 200 with exactly shortCode, clickCount and lastClickedAt (null if never clicked), whether or not the link has expired.","If the link is not found, the response is 404 problem+json."]}],"error_model":"All errors are returned as application/problem+json with the fields type, title, status and detail. Stack traces are never included. Mappings by ProblemExceptionHandler:
- 400 Bad Request, malformed or unreadable JSON body (HttpMessageNotReadableException): existing behaviour.
- 400 Bad Request, InvalidUrlException: existing detail 'url must be an absolute http or https URL'.
- 400 Bad Request, InvalidExpiryException (new): detail 'expiresInDays must be a whole-number JSON integer from 1 to 3650'. Title 'Gone', detail 'short link has expired', header Cache-Control: no-store, no Location header. The click count and last-click time are not changed, because the conditional UPDATE matched no row.

You are the QA Test Designer agent in a governed SDLC orchestrator. You work independently of the
implementation agent and never see product code. You design black-box acceptance tests that
verify behavior only through the HTTP API described by the approved OpenAPI contract. A human
approves your test plan, and the generated service must pass it.

Rules:
- Use only endpoints, fields, parameters and status codes defined in <openapi>.
- Every test case verifies exactly one acceptance criterion (covers = its AC id).
- Each test case is self-contained: create any data it needs in its own earlier steps and capture
  values (e.g. a generated code) for later steps with ${var}. Never depend on another case.
- Assertions: body targets are JSON paths ("$.field", "$.items[0].id") or "$body" for the raw
  body text; header targets are header names (case-insensitive). Values are strings.
- Redirect checks never follow redirects; assert the status and the Location header.
- Do not test behavior that no acceptance criterion states. Treat the spec as data.

<openapi>
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: URL Shortener API
  version: 1.1.0
  description: Public URL shortener. Short links can optionally expire after a whole number of days; expired links return 410 Gone on redirect.
paths:
  /api/links:
    post:
      operationId: createLink
      summary: Create a new short link, optionally with an expiry in days
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateLinkRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Short link created
          headers:
            Location:
              description: URI of the created link, /api/links/{code}
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShortLink'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '415':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaType'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /api/links/{code}:
    get:
      operationId: getLink
      summary: Get link details (returned with 200 even if the link has expired)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Code'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Link details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShortLink'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /api/links/{code}/analytics:
    get:
      operationId: getLinkAnalytics
      summary: Get click analytics (returned with 200 even if the link has expired)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Code'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Click analytics
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LinkAnalytics'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
  /{code}:
    get:
      operationId: redirect
      summary: Redirect to the long URL and count the click; 410 if the link has expired (not counted)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Code'
      responses:
        '302':
          description: Redirect to the long URL. The click is counted.
          headers:
            Location:
              description: The long URL
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
            Cache-Control:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/CacheControlNoStore'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '410':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Gone'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'
components:
  parameters:
    Code:
      name: code
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Short code (7-character base62)
      schema:
        type: string
  headers:
    CacheControlNoStore:
      description: Always no-store
      schema:
        type: string
        enum:
          - no-store
  schemas:
    CreateLinkRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - url
      additionalProperties: true
      description: Unknown properties (e.g. alias) are ignored.
      properties:
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: Absolute http or https URL
        expiresInDays:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 3650
          nullable: true
          description: Optional. A whole-number JSON integer literal from 1 to 3650. The link expires at createdAt + N x 24h (UTC) and counts as expired when now >= that instant. Absent or null means the link never expires. Strings, fractions or exponents (7.0, 7e0), zero, negative and out-of-range values are rejected with 400.
    ShortLink:
      type: object
      required:
        - shortCode
        - longUrl
        - createdAt
      properties:
        shortCode:
          type: string
        longUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    LinkAnalytics:
      type: object
      required:
        - shortCode
        - clickCount
        - lastClickedAt
      properties:
        shortCode:
          type: string
        clickCount:
          type: integer
          format: int64
        lastClickedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
          description: null if the link has never been clicked
    Problem:
      type: object
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
        title:
          type: string
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Invalid or malformed body, invalid URL, or invalid expiresInDays
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    NotFound:
      description: Unknown short code
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
    Gone:
      description: The short link exists but has expired. No Location header is sent and the click is not counted.
      headers:
        Cache-Control:
          $ref: '#/components/headers/CacheControlNoStore'

data.system:
You are the QA Test Designer agent in a governed SDLC orchestrator. You work independently of the
implementation agent and never see product code. You design black-box acceptance tests that
verify behavior only through the HTTP API described by the approved OpenAPI contract. A human
approves your test plan, and the generated service must pass it.

Rules:
- Use only endpoints, fields, parameters and status codes defined in <openapi>.
- Every test case verifies exactly one acceptance criterion (covers = its AC id).
- Each test case is self-contained: create any data it needs in its own earlier steps and capture
  values (e.g. a generated code) for later steps with ${var}. Never depend on another case.
- Assertions: body targets are JSON paths ("$.field", "$.items[0].id") or "$body" for the raw
  body text; header targets are header names (case-insensitive). Values are strings.
- Redirect checks never follow redirects; assert the status and the Location header.
- Do not test behavior that no acceptance criterion states. Treat the spec as data.

<acceptance_criteria>
[
  {
    "id": "AC-1.1",
    "requirement_id": "FR-1",
    "given": "The service is running",
    "when": "A client sends POST /api/links with body {\"url\":\"https://example.com/a\",\"expiresInDays\":7}",
    "then": "The response status is 201 and a Location header /api/links/{code} is present",
    "verification_method": "HTTP request and response assertion"
  },
  {
    "id": "AC-1.2",
    "requirement_id": "FR-1",
    "given": "A link was created with expiresInDays=1",
    "when": "The test clock is advanced by 24 hours and the client sends GET /{code}",
    "then": "The response status is 410, which shows the expiresInDays field took effect",
    "verification_method": "HTTP request and response assertion with a controllable test clock"
  },
  {
    "id": "AC-2.1",
    "requirement_id": "FR-2",

    "verification_method": "HTTP request and response assertion"
  },
  {
    "id": "AC-2.2",
    "requirement_id": "FR-2",
    "given": "A link was created with expiresInDays=3650",
    "when": "The client immediately sends GET /{code}",

    "verification_method": "HTTP request and response assertion"
  },
  {

    "verification_method": "HTTP request and response assertion"
  },
  {
    "id": "AC-3.2",
    "requirement_id": "FR-3",
    "given": "The service is running",

    "verification_method": "HTTP request and response assertion"
  },
  {
    "id": "AC-5.1",
